name: map-browser
title: Map browser
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A filterable list and a map that stay in sync: hover, selection, native clusters and a detail panel. The list is the accessible source.

meta.descriptionEs: Lista filtrable y mapa sincronizados: hover, selección, clústeres nativos y panel de detalle. La lista es la fuente accesible.

examples.title: Valle inventado
examples.description: Dieciséis lugares ficticios, filtro por tipo, clústeres y detalle.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero, uno y quinientos lugares, textos largos, 390 px, inglés y RTL.

meta.usage: <MapBrowser places={filtered} total={all.length} provider={provider} categories={categories} toolbar={<FilterToolbar … />} onSelectedChange={setId} />

api.name: places / total
api.description: Places already filtered by the host, and the count before filtering. total tells empty (0) from nomatch.

api.name: provider
api.description: styles.light and styles.dark (URL, style object, or a factory that reads host tokens), attribution (required, always expanded), workerUrl (self-hosted), maxZoom. No tile provider is built in.

api.name: status
api.description: Data state. A map that cannot render is its own state: the list keeps working.

api.name: categories
api.description: id, label and a chart-1..5 tone. Tones are host tokens, never colors.

api.name: toolbar
api.description: Usually a host-controlled FilterToolbar. Filtering lives in the host.

api.name: selectedId / defaultSelectedId / onSelectedChange
api.description: One selection shared by the card and the pin. Escape or close returns focus to where it came from.

api.name: renderCard / renderDetail
api.description: Slots for the card body and the detail. The detail is a side panel when the piece is 48rem or wider, a bottom sheet below.

api.name: cluster
api.description: Native maplibre clustering drawn as named DOM buttons. On by default above 50 places.

api.name: onRetry / onClearFilters
api.description: Actions for the error and nomatch states.

api.name: labels
api.description: Chrome copy. es-MX is the default; mapBrowserLabelsEn is exported.

api.name: className / classNames
api.description: Root class and slot classes: toolbar, body, list, card, map, pin, cluster, detail.

docs: PropXYZ: referencia clean-room, no se copió código ni assets. El mapa se adaptó de MapCN (MIT License · Copyright (c) 2025 Anmoldeep Singh); ver NOTICE. maplibre-gl es BSD-3-Clause. La pieza no trae proveedor de tiles, CSS global, tema, cssVars ni colores fijos: el anfitrión importa maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css, sirve el worker y pasa provider.workerUrl. Con CARTO se usa una API key propia, la atribución queda visible y sin colapsar, el tope comercial es de 1M de tiles al mes y no se cachean ni se pasan tiles por un proxy; ver docs/map-browser.md. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no.
